I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread. I said I've noted that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats and that, as he asked, I haven't changed anything. I also told him the earlier number in #central-team stays as it is unless he posts a correction there himself.

A seat count isn't a money figure, so it was fine to repeat it in that channel. Tobias had already posted it there anyway. No approval was needed.
